newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup-USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 per cwt higher. F
eedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Best demand for steers, while heifers under 1050 lbs finding narrow outlets and some discounts.

Sales reported on 36,300 slaughter steers and 16,500 slaughter heifers; 76,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,400 formulated cattle and 1,900 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00 to mostly 69.00. Select, few Choice 1150-1250 lbs 68.00-68.50. Few Mostly Select 1100 lb 66.00-67.00. Few dressed basis Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 110.75.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 68.00 to mostly 69.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 67.00-68.50.
Wk to Date - 76,100 Week Ago - 16,600 Year Ago - 13,100
